editorial:
Imagine you are watching a fake ghost hunting show where the crew doesn't actually believe in ghosts. That is how you start this ride. You follow a team of TV personalities who break into an old, creepy psychiatric hospital to film a special episode. At first, they just joke around and fake their evidence to get higher ratings. The vibe is light and funny, but it quickly turns into a nightmare when they realize the doors are locked and the building itself is changing around them. You feel the panic grow as they realize they are not alone in those dark hallways.

What really works here is how the movie tricks you into feeling trapped. The pacing starts slow but picks up speed until it is a full-blown sprint for survival. While some of the acting feels a bit over the top, it fits the fake reality show style perfectly. If you love jump scares and a creepy setting, you will have a blast. For the best experience, you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see all the grime in the hospital. If you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move for a movie night with friends.
endingExplained: By the end, the crew has completely lost their minds. The hospital has absorbed them into its walls. In the final scene, the main character is the only one left. He finds a mirror and sees a demonic version of himself staring back. He realizes there is no way out of the building. He screams in terror as the monster grabs him, showing that the hospital always keeps its guests forever.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves found-footage horror and jump scares.
